value.rationale: A precise counterexample to a blanket exclusion in a published mathematical-physics transport model is scientifically motivated and falsifiable. The result identifies a strong-trap Zeno regime in which the heuristic antipodal no-assistance rule fails and supplies an exact rational (not merely numerical) certificate. A single ten-site witness is meaningful because the contradicted statement quantified over every cycle and parameter choice; a full phase diagram is not a prerequisite for this boundary correction.
